title: Evaluating Accuracy and Probabilistic Reliability of Zero-Shot Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.25788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) promise a paradigm shift toward zero-shot forecasting by eliminating task-specific training. However, existing works often overlook trade-offs between predictive accuracy and probabilistic calibration. This paper presents a benchmark study of six TSFMs evaluated on energy, traffic, and financial datasets. We contrast their performance against statistical baselines and a supervised DL model. The study reveals that while TSFMs outperform statistical methods and supervised models, they are subject to a fundamental trade-off between point accuracy and probabilistic reliability. Specifically, xLSTM architectures provide robust probabilistic calibration across horizons. In contrast, patch-based transformers offer competitive accuracy but face calibration issues at long horizons, while transformer-based models exhibit context saturation points for optimal zero-shot reasoning. translated_title: 评估零样本时间序列基础模型的准确性与概率可靠性
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）通过消除任务特定训练的需求，有望实现零样本预测的范式转变。然而，现有研究往往忽视了预测准确性与概率校准之间的权衡。本文对六个时间序列基础模型在能源、交通和金融数据集上进行了基准测试研究，并将其性能与统计基线方法和监督深度学习模型进行对比。研究表明，尽管TSFM优于统计方法和监督模型，但它们在点预测准确性与概率可靠性之间存在根本性的权衡。具体而言，xLSTM架构在各种预测时间跨度上都能提供稳健的概率校准；相比之下，基于补丁的Transformer模型具有有竞争力的准确性，但在长时间跨度上面临校准问题，而基于Transformer的模型则表现出用于最优零样本推理的上下文饱和点。这些发现为理解TSFM的能力与局限提供了实证依据。
tldr: 本研究对六个时间序列基础模型进行了基准测试，发现零样本预测中存在点准确性与概率可靠性之间的根本权衡：xLSTM架构校准最稳健，基于补丁的Transformer准确性有竞争力但长预测期校准欠佳，而Transformer模型存在上下文饱和点。
en_tdlr: This benchmark study of six time series foundation models reveals a fundamental trade-off between point accuracy and probabilistic reliability in zero-shot forecasting, with xLSTM architectures offering robust calibration, patch-based transformers facing calibration issues at long horizons, and transformer-based models exhibiting context saturation points.
